items.title: Last road game: Huskies vs. North Dakota State
items.summary: NIU football will hit the road one last time this season to take on the North Dakota State University Bisons on Saturday at Fargo, North Dakota. items.title: NIU Eyes Final Road Trip of 2026 Season at North Dakota State
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University football team gears up for one final road trip in the 2026 campaign, heading to Fargo, N.D. to take on fellow first-year conference foe North Dakota State. Saturday's game is set for 3 p.m. CT on The CW with Jack McMullen, Cody Kessler and Marshall Newhouse on the call.

items.title: This Week In Huskie Athletics: November 16, 2026

items.title: NIU Drops Home Conference Contest to Nevada
items.summary: DEKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University Huskies fell to Nevada, 28-7, on Saturday afternoon (Nov. 14) at Huskie Stadium as the Wolf Pack turned three Huskie turnovers into 14 points. Nevada rushed for 308 yards in the contest, led by 153 yards on 13 carries and two touchdowns from Herschel Turner Jr.

items.summary: Still trying for its first win, NIU football (0-9, 0-5 Mountain West) will host the University of Nevada (3-6, 2-3 MW) on Saturday. Nevada, coached by Jeff Choate, runs its offense through multiple quarterbacks, with sophomore Carter Jones and fifth-year AJ Bianco getting the majority of snaps. items.title: Huskies Return Home to Face Nevada
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University football team is back at home this weekend, welcoming Nevada to Huskie Stadium. NIU last played at home on Oct. 24 and have played in three road contests in the last four games. Kickoff on Saturday is scheduled for 2:30 p.m. CT and will be broadcast on MW+ with Matt Rodewald and Clay Harbor on the call.

items.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif. – The Northern Illinois University football team erased an early 13-point deficit Saturday afternoon against the San Josè State Spartans at CEFCU Stadium, but two Spartans touchdowns early in the third quarter got the hosts past NIU 30-19.

items.title: Huskies Set Sights on San José State
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University football team closes out back-to-back road games this weekend, making a trip to San José State on Saturday, Nov. 7 at 3 p.m. CT. Saturday's conference game between the Huskies and Spartans will be broadcasted on MW+ and NBC Sports Bay Area. The radio broadcast on 94-9 WDKB begins at 2:30 p.m. CT.

items.title: This Week In Huskie Athletics – Nov. 3, 2026
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – The Northern Illinois University men's soccer team can clinch the Horizon League regular season championship today as men's and women's basketball, football, volleyball and wrestling all go on the road this weekend.

items.title: Huskies Take UNLV To The Wire, Fall 31-24
items.summary: LAS VEGAS, Nev. – The Northern Illinois University football team put up 493 yards of total offense Saturday night but could not pull even with the UNLV Rebels in a 31-24 loss at Allegiant Stadium Saturday night.

items.title: DeAree Rogers Named to Biletnikoff Award Watch List
items.summary: DeKALB, Ill. – Wide Receiver DeAree Rogers of the Northern Illinois University football team has been named to the Biletnikoff Award Watch List, the Tallahassee Quarterback Club (TQC) Foundation announced today. The Biletnikoff Award annually recognizes the college football season's outstanding FBS receiver.
